description: Build a company-wide Finance Operations web app for payables, reimbursements, payroll-summary imports, school-customer billing, Tutor Advantage reconciliation, historical accounting-report import, and monthly Thai-accountant handoff.
deviation_notes: Planning only. Finance Operations is a separate global company-finance boundary from Company Operations CRM and every school/product database. Tutor Advantage remains the operational source of truth for its payments, enrollments, network commissions, settlement approval, payouts, transfers, and payout documents.

sprint.goal: Give the company one controlled finance-operations surface that produces a reconciled, immutable monthly accountant pack without replacing the accountant's statutory ledger or duplicating product-owned financial workflows.
